Slightly biased review. We built SolonGate too. :) Fompi's AI data masking actually grew out of our work on SolonGate's Shadow AI security technology. Instead of reinventing everything, we brought parts of that infrastructure into a tiny, local-first security companion. SolonGate is also part of Anthropic's Cyber Verification Program and the OpenAI and Red Hat partner ecosystems. Some of our research has been supported by Emergent Ventures at George Mason University. Same security roots. Much smaller, greener body. [...] Launching today
